name: Burning Rockslide
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World
description: Smoldering boulders are disgorged by the magmatic soil and roll down the slope, catching fire as they descend.
disable: DC 16 Nature (trained), Physical Science Lore|dc:16 (trained), or DC 16 Survival (trained) to guess the rocks' path, or a DC 18 Acrobatics (trained), DC 18 Athletics (trained) or a DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw save to deflect or dodge rocks.

defensiveAbilities.name: Catching Fire
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Creatures climb the slope

Effect Molten lava oozes down the slope, coming perilously close to the path and igniting the debris nearby—even the rocks. All creatures in a 30ft Type:burst take (1d10+4) Bludgeoning Damage|options:area-damage] damage with a Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a critical failure the creature also catches on fire.
